facts.fact: Abeokuta North Local Government's chairman said a digital revenue collection system would start on the Wednesday after a Monday press conference, onboarding petrol stations on a pump-based levy and later markets, with all levies and taxes paid digitally.

facts.fact: Only Abeokuta North Local Government is named as starting the digital revenue collection system, onboarding payers from the week after the press conference.
